tips.text: Split into east and west teams; lure Gaitz off the center path within 5 to 6 turns
From Turn 7, flames spread outward from your start: send Mov 4 Buccar and Esmeralda first
Destroy the southwest and southeast artillery, and stand on protection tiles
Song of Angels (if you have it) on the boss turn, with Sirocco, Inyoni, Guzran and Esmeralda
